editorial.blurb: Garuda brings authentic Indonesian home cooking to Chicago with remarkably affordable, flavorful dishes and genuinely warm hospitality that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive around 7pm and put your name down immediately—expect a 30-40 minute wait, but it moves faster if you go family-style and order multiple dishes to share.

topDishes.note: Consistently praised as a top contender with rich, authentic flavor
Once voted world's most delicious food; genuinely rich and true to tradition
Incredibly flavorful with care and fresh ingredients throughout
